devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE class provides comprehensive verification and action flows for HP Experience (HPX) devices micro-frontend. This class is responsible for device management operations, including verifying UI elements, managing device cards, handling user authentication, and interacting with various device-related components in the HP application. It ensures robust interaction and validation of device-related features within the HPX ecosystem.
